title: job.kind@1
description: An offline job kind and the tools that join it: the kind names its params schema, its outputs, its key, its output checks and its qualification fixtures; a tool, pinned by name@version, joins only once it writes each fixture's expected bytes, and an output reaches an item only after every output check passes.
